body: Lead spec of a 2-layer sequenced program (author choice 2026-06-15): sibling-context FIRST, hierarchical head SECOND, each shipped as a gated PATCH (NOT 0.7.0). Builds on the abandoned 2026-03-24-sibling-context-multi-branch (closed 0/7, stranded at integration). See memory sibling-context-is-the-stranded-architecture-layer.
